## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
- DD2: HOOKS-REFERENCE.md, CI-INTEGRATION.md, WORKTREE-GUIDE.md, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md updated coherently.
- DD4: CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE reports surfaced to user for approval.

## Implementation Notes

This task acts as the documentation umbrella, verifying coherence across the doc updates landed by S2.T11 (cycle-ledger.md), S3.T5 (CI-INTEGRATION provenance skip), S4.T5 (CI-INTEGRATION merge-pipeline-checks), S6.T6 (WORKTREE-GUIDE), S7.T10 (CI-INTEGRATION large-diff + CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE), and S_mig.T10 (cutover runbook).

1. **Audit pass**: Read each updated reference doc; verify cross-links between sections; flag missing references.
2. **HOOKS-REFERENCE.md update**: Add a section describing any new hook signals introduced by the epic (review-sub-pr workflow trigger, DSO_SUPPRESS_PRIOR_DEFENSES consumer, etc.). If no new hooks were added, document this verdict.
3. **CLAUDE.md gates**: Run doc-router gates. Any gate that fires for CLAUDE.md MUST emit a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — NEVER edit CLAUDE.md directly (per epic Constraint #6).
4. **Cross-link audit**: ensure each updated doc references the others where appropriate (e.g., CI-INTEGRATION.md sub-PR review section links to the ADR from T1).

If no CLAUDE.md changes are needed, document this verdict in the ticket comment.

Doc-router Gate 2 fired (existing reference docs).

## File Impact
| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|---|---|---|---|
| `plugins/dso/docs/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md` | modify | n/a (instruction) | still-valid |
| `plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md` | modify (cross-link audit) | n/a | still-valid |
| `plugins/dso/docs/WORKTREE-GUIDE.md` | modify (cross-link audit) | n/a | still-valid |
| `plugins/dso/docs/CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md` | modify (cross-link audit) | n/a | still-valid |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] HOOKS-REFERENCE.md updated OR verdict comment present
  Verify: git diff --stat plugins/dso/docs/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md 2>/dev/null | grep -q HOOKS-REFERENCE || .claude/scripts/dso ticket show cdc0-8cfc-38e6-4e7d 2>&1 | grep -qE 'HOOKS_AUDIT|no.new.hooks'
- [ ] CI-INTEGRATION.md cross-links to ADR
  Verify: F=$(ls docs/adr/[0-9]*-version-bump-design.md | head -1) && grep -qE "adr.*$(basename "$F")|version-bump-design" plugins/dso/docs/CI-INTEGRATION.md
- [ ] If CLAUDE.md changes needed, CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report attached as ticket comment
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show cdc0-8cfc-38e6-4e7d 2>&1 | grep -qE 'CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE|CLAUDE.md.*no.changes.needed'

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet); escalate.
